response.sql:
WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT
    o.recordvault AS ordersmark,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(e.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS e
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    timespan,
    avg_fill,
    avg_fill - AVG(avg_fill) OVER (PARTITION BY timespan) AS above_tif_avg,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY timespan
      ORDER BY avg_fill DESC
    ) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_fills
)
SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, above_tif_avg, fill_rank
FROM compared
WHERE avg_fill > (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill)
  FROM order_fills AS peer
  WHERE peer.timespan = compared.timespan
)
  AND fill_rank <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, fill_rank;

assumptions.assumption: The time-in-force average is the mean of per-order average fills among matched orders, computed separately for each timespan; orders with no non-NULL fillcount have a NULL average and are excluded by the strict comparison.
